---
title: "Confidence interval"
params:
  lang: en
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)

hook(s_d, subscript(s, D))
hook(n, N)
hook(xbar, mean(x))
hook(quant90, subscript(t, "0.90"))
hook(quant95, subscript(t, "0.975"))
hook(mu0, subscript(mu, 0L))
hook(se, italic(SE))
hook(q95, "95%")
hook(q90, "90%")


task <- "confint6"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package="mistakes"))

source("utility.R")

## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  n <- as.integer(round(runif(1, min=25, max=35)))
  mu0 <- round(runif(1, 8, 14)) 
  xbar <- mu0 - round(runif(1, 0.5, 3),1) 
  s_d <- round(runif(1, 2.5, 4),1)

  quant90 <- qt(0.95, n - 1)
  quant95 <- qt(0.975, n - 1)

  Q <- quote(search(confint6, confint6(n, xbar, mu0, s_d, quant90, quant95), .S, .R, .P, .E))
  S <- findall(Q, options=list(preproc=as.rolog), env=environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next

  break
}

t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(t$correct, t$explanations, t$bugs, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra)
```

Question
========

A sample of $N=`r n`$ graduate students took part in a program 
designed to reduce their performance anxiety before an oral presentation. 
The researchers expected the mean anxiety score after the program to be lower 
than the reference value of $\mu_0=`r mu0`$ points. At the end of the program, the students completed a questionnaire. 
Their mean score is $\overline{X}=`r xbar`$ points, and their sample standard deviation is $s_D=`r s_d`$ points. 

Assuming that well-being scores are approximately normally distributed, 
calculate the two-sided $90\%$ confidence interval. 


```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
The two-sided $90\%$ confidence interval is calculated by: `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```
